;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**A [[September 2018 Kabul attacks|suicide attack]] at a wrestling club in a [[Hazaras|Hazara]] [[Shi’ite]] neighborhood of the [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] capital [[Kabul]] and a second explosion apparently targeting emergency services and journalists kills at least 20 people and wounds 70 others. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast/at-least-20-dead-as-twin-blasts-hit-afghan-capital-idUSKCN1LL1XI (Reuters)]
*[[Israel]]’s [[Supreme Court of Israel|Supreme Court]] rejects appeals against the demolition of [[Khan al-Ahmar (village)|Khan al-Ahmar]] in the occupied [[West Bank]] whose fate has been a subject of international concern. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/world-middle-east-45420915 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Tropical Storm Gordon (2018)|Tropical Storm Gordon]] makes landfall near the [[Alabama]]–[[Mississippi]] border in the [[United States]]. One death is reported. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/09/04/us/tropical-storm-gordon-preparation-wxc/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Hurricane Florence]], the sixth named storm of 2018, becomes the first major Atlantic hurricane of the year as it strengthens to a [[Saffir–Simpson scale#Category 3|category 3]] hurricane. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2018/09/05/hurricane-florence-becomes-first-major-storm-2018-atlantic-season.html (Fox News)] [https://www.sfgate.com/news/us/article/Florence-becomes-first-major-hurricane-of-13205999.php (SFgate.com)] 
*An [[Iran]]ian man attempts [[self-immolation]] in front of the [[Tehran]] city hall. [https://en.trend.az/iran/society/2947222.html (Trend)]
*Emirates Flight 203 from [[Dubai]] is quarantined briefly after landing at [[John F. Kennedy International Airport]] when 19 passengers were deemed sick and others complained of symptoms. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/travel/flights/todayinthesky/2018/09/05/quarantined-emirates-380-arrives-new-york-100-ill-passengers/1200607002/ (''USA Today'')]

;International relations
*[[Israel–Paraguay relations]]
**[[Paraguay]] announces that it will move its embassy in [[Israel]] from [[Jerusalem]] to [[Tel Aviv]], reversing a May decision to move it from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, citing efforts to achieve peace in the [[Middle East]]. In response, [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] orders the closure of Israel's embassy in Paraguay. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-paraguay-israel/paraguay-to-move-embassy-in-israel-back-to-tel-aviv-foreign-minister-idUSKCN1LL2HE (Reuters)], [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-paraguay-israel-netanyahu/israel-closing-embassy-in-paraguay-after-it-ordered-return-of-mission-to-tel-aviv-idUSKCN1LL2KG (Reuters<sub>2</sub>)]
*[[Bolivarian diaspora]], [[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**After an emergency summit, eleven nations of Latin America (including [[Colombia]], [[Brazil]], [[Ecuador]], and [[Peru]]) announce that they will all admit Venezuelan migrants without the required travel documents. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45419665 (BBC)]
*[[China–Togo relations]]
**[[Wang Huning]], a senior official of the [[Communist Party of China]], meets with [[Togo]]lese President [[Faure Gnassingbé]] in [[Beijing]], [[China]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-09/06/c_137447576.htm (Xinhua)]

;Law and crime
*[[Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]] 
**[[British government|British authorities]] charge two men for their alleged involvement in a [[Novichok]] poisoning earlier in 2018, claiming the men are agents of the [[GRU (Russian Federation)|GRU]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/09/05/644782096/u-k-charges-2-russians-suspected-of-poison-attack-on-skripals (NPR)]
**[[Russia]] says that the [[United Kingdom]] declines to provide them with the suspects' fingerprints. [http://tass.com/politics/1020130 (TASS)]
*[[Kidnapping of Joshua Boyle and Caitlan Coleman#Child custody battle|Kidnapping of Joshua Boyle and Caitlan Coleman]], [[Weinstein effect]]
**[[Caitlan Coleman]], an American woman kidnapped and held hostage for five years in [[Afghanistan]], accused her husband Joshua Boyle physically and emotionally abusing her while the family was being held by [[Taliban]]-linked militants. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/sep/05/caitlan-coleman-joshua-boyle-family-hostage-afghanistan-abuse (''The Guardian'')] 

;Politics and elections
*[[First presidency of Donald Trump|Presidency of Donald Trump]]
**''[[The New York Times]]'' publishes [[I Am Part of the Resistance Inside the Trump Administration|an editorial]] written by an anonymous [[senior administration official]] in the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] which criticizes U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] and claims unnamed administration aides and officials, in efforts to promote national stability, conspired against the president. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/white-house-official-new-york-times-trump-1.4811931 (AP via CBC)]

;Science and technology
*[[International Space Station maintenance]]
**The Director General of [[Roscosmos]], [[Dmitry Rogozin]], says the 2mm hole detected on the [[International Space Station]] (ISS) last week was caused, possibly deliberately, by someone using a drill, and that an investigation is under way to find out who is responsible. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2018/sep/05/space-station-air-leak-someone-drilled-the-hole-say-russians (''The Guardian'')]
